pages.text: A Mudsnout Boar's hide is $(item)Blackhide Leather$(), thick, smoky and tougher than any cow's. Stitched into armor it turns more than iron does, though it is no match for diamond. The helmet needs two $(item)Mudsnout Tusks$() set on either side, the way the boar wears them.

pages.title: Leggings & Boots
pages.text: Defense 3, 7, 5 and 3: 18 in all, between iron and diamond, with a little toughness.

pages.title: Thick Hide
pages.text: Each piece worn has a 5% chance to turn an arrow aside, so a full set deflects one in five. Thrown tridents and spears are heavier than that and still pierce the hide.

pages.title: Charge
pages.text: Wear all four pieces and a long sprint builds $(thing)momentum$(): the longer you run, the faster you go, up to 25% faster after three seconds. At top speed you are $(thing)Charged$().$(br2)A Charge lasts up to 12 seconds. Hold it longer and you are winded, and cannot build momentum for 3 seconds.

pages.title: Impact
pages.text: While Charged, run into something and it is flung away with 4 damage, and you keep charging. A second ram ends the Charge and winds you.$(br2)Hit it instead and the blow throws it too. A fist launches as hard as a ram. A weapon launches it further and hits 25% harder. Either spends the Charge, and you have to build it again.
